question: Who among the following replaced Morarji Desai as the Prime Minister of India in 1979?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charan Singh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Charan Singh** was the 5th Prime Minister of India between **1979 and 1980.**
 
• He was the** 3rd Deputy Prime Minister of India.**
 
• He became the Deputy Prime Minister of India in the Morarji Desai government in 1977.
 
• Charan Singh was the first prime minister in India **to head a minority government in the center.**
 
• He is one of the the **shortest-serving prime minister in India whose tenre was of 170 days.**
 
• **Kisan ghat** is the resting place of Charan Singh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jagjivan Ram** was the fourth deputy prime minister of India who served during the tenure of the Morarji Desai and Charan Singh governments.
 
• **Devi Lal **was the sixth Deputy Prime Minister of India who served during the tenure of **V. P. Singh and Chandra Shekhar governments.**
 
• **Chandrasekhar** was the eighth Prime Minister of India between 1990 and 1991.
